description: Defines the Time class and TimeAsLocal class for handling date and time operations, including conversions, formatting, and parsing in different formats. Contains constants, member functions, and operator overloads related to time management.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Represents a point in time with methods for parsing, formatting, and manipulating date/time values, supporting different platforms (Windows/POSIX).

classes.name: TimeAsLocal
classes.description: Wraps a Time object to handle local time internally, providing conversions and operator overloads.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a Time object, supporting multiple date formats.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object to a string in RFC1123 format.

methods.name: WeekDayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the weekday.

methods.name: MonthName
methods.description: Returns the name of the month.

methods.name: MilliSeconds
methods.description: Returns milliseconds component of the time.

methods.name: Seconds
methods.description: Returns seconds component of the time.

methods.name: Minutes
methods.description: Returns minutes component of the time.

methods.name: Hours
methods.description: Returns hours component of the time.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns time in microseconds from epoch.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the time with a custom formatter.
